findings.highlight: No can do. We’re fasting today.
findings.evidenceJa: だめでござる。今日は断食するでござる
findings.governingReading: Shirou improvises an exaggerated samurai register by repeating ござる.
findings.explanation: The English supplies casual slang but removes the period-role performance that launches the joke.

findings.highlight: Provisions exhausted, ready for my last stand.
findings.evidenceJa: 兵糧既に尽き背水の河氾濫せり
findings.governingReading: The mock-military proclamation says the provisions are gone and the river at their backs has flooded.
findings.explanation: Last stand replaces the absurd flooded-river escalation with a generic military cliché.

findings.highlight: I reply on reflex.
findings.evidenceJa: シークタイムゼロ、脊髄反射で返答したよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says his seek time was zero and he answered by spinal reflex, colliding machine and bodily metaphors.
findings.explanation: Reflex generalizes away the specific spinal image and weakens the deliberate metaphor collision.

findings.highlight: We had hamburgers for breakfast
findings.evidenceJa: 朝はハンバーグだった
findings.governingReading: Breakfast was hamburger steak.
findings.explanation: Hamburgers again changes the plated Japanese dish into sandwiches.

findings.highlight: We’re in the middle of the training
findings.evidenceJa: せっかくセイバーと竹刀を合わせるんだから
findings.governingReading: Shirou wants to make use of the opportunity to cross bamboo swords with Saber.
findings.explanation: Generic training removes Saber, the swords, and the sense of valuing this particular chance.

findings.highlight: Our conversation has not finished
findings.evidenceJa: 話はまったく、一手たりとも進んでいません
findings.governingReading: Saber protests that the discussion has not advanced by even a single move.
findings.explanation: Not finished loses her complaint that Shirou has made literally no argumentative progress and removes the tactical metaphor.

findings.highlight: This is your final warning, Shirou. Please make lunch right now!
findings.evidenceJa: これが最後ですシロウ、今すぐ昼食にしてください
findings.governingReading: Saber says this is the last time she will say it and demands lunch immediately.
findings.explanation: Final warning adds an explicit threat to her desperate last demand.

findings.highlight: my body wants energy
findings.evidenceJa: 体は栄養を必要としている
findings.governingReading: Saber denies consciously feeling hunger and attributes the reaction to her body requiring nutrition.
findings.explanation: Energy blurs ordinary nutrition into the magical-energy terminology used immediately later.

findings.highlight: If you forget modesty
findings.evidenceJa: 嗜みを忘れてたら
findings.governingReading: Illya taunts Saber about forgetting a lady’s decorum or cultivated manners.
findings.explanation: Modesty again narrows public propriety into personal or sexual reserve.

findings.highlight: the growling of the stomach is caused by movements of stomach called hunger contraction
findings.evidenceJa: 腹の虫は飢餓収縮と呼ばれる胃腸の動きが原因である
findings.governingReading: The narration attributes stomach growling to gastrointestinal movement called hunger contraction.
findings.explanation: The English omits required articles and agreement, making the pseudo-physiological explanation grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: your energy consumption is pretty high considering how much you ate this morning
findings.evidenceJa: 朝あんなに食べてたのに燃費悪いぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Saber gets poor mileage despite eating so much at breakfast.
findings.explanation: Energy consumption states the literal inference and removes the insulting vehicle-efficiency metaphor.

findings.highlight: Saber always finishes her meal.
findings.evidenceJa: ほっといたら最後までごはん食べてる
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that if left unchecked Saber will keep eating right through to the end.
findings.explanation: Always finishes her meal turns excessive duration and quantity into ordinary plate-clearing.

findings.highlight: happy that she was able to disparage Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを遣り込めたのが嬉しい
findings.governingReading: Illya is delighted that she managed to get the better of Saber in the exchange.
findings.explanation: Disparage recasts her victory in the argument as merely speaking slightingly about Saber.

findings.highlight: If the Master can’t replenish your magical energy, you have to take in magical energy yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターから魔力が補充されないんだから、セイバーは自分で魔力を蓄えるしかない
findings.governingReading: The obsolete explanation that no magical energy comes from the Master is commented out; the active line says the established line still leaves no margin.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores a deleted rule statement that conflicts with the current connection state.

findings.highlight: Saber can only create enough magical energy to keep herself alive.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが一日で作れる魔力は、一日の存在に必要な量に満たない
findings.governingReading: The magical energy Saber can generate in one day is insufficient for the amount required to exist for that day.
findings.explanation: Enough reverses the deficit into sufficiency, undermining the reason she must conserve and supplement energy.

findings.highlight: We will cruise through lightly as always.
findings.evidenceJa: いつも通り、軽く流していきます
findings.governingReading: Fully armored Saber coldly claims she will go through the spar lightly as usual.
findings.explanation: Cruise through lightly is unnatural English and weakens the ironic threat preceding her overwhelming strike.

findings.highlight: Saber attacks me violently.
findings.evidenceJa: その牙を突きたてた
findings.governingReading: Freed from the restraint of acting as instructor, Saber sinks her fangs into Shirou without mercy.
findings.explanation: Attacks violently removes the predatory image that caps her controlled retaliation.

findings.highlight: the spiritual world that takes you to heaven, congratulating you for dying
findings.evidenceJa: 命を終えた貴方を昇天させる心霊ワールド
findings.governingReading: Tiger Dojo is introduced as a spirit world that sends upward the soul of someone who died through a minor mistake.
findings.explanation: Congratulating invents approval of the death and garbles the function assigned to the parody afterlife.

findings.highlight: in life, you should take simple precautions or the wounds will last forever
findings.evidenceJa: 人生注意一秒怪我一生
findings.governingReading: The line twists the compact safety slogan “one second of caution, a lifetime of injury.”
findings.explanation: The explanatory paraphrase loses the balanced slogan form and its recognizable comic mechanism.

findings.highlight: one of us, the Tigers
findings.evidenceJa: 我ら虎ッカーの一員
findings.governingReading: The false choice offers membership in Tocker, a tiger-themed evil-organization parody name.
findings.explanation: The Tigers removes the coined organization name and most of the tokusatsu parody signal.

findings.highlight: I am ashamed that you could not even dodge the first blow.
findings.evidenceJa: 初撃も躱せないとは情けない
findings.governingReading: Saber judges Shirou pathetic for failing to evade even the opening strike.
findings.explanation: The English assigns shame to Saber and softens her direct contempt for Shirou’s performance.

findings.highlight: will retort thoroughly when angered
findings.evidenceJa: 怒るととことんまでやり返してくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that when Saber is angry, she retaliates and gets even all the way.
findings.explanation: Retort confines her violent physical payback to a verbal reply and is nonidiomatic with thoroughly.
